feed.headline: McBride caught eight of nine targets for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 31-7 loss to Seattle.
feed.description: McBride caught eight of nine targets for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 31-7 loss to Seattle.
feed.story: McBride was the lone bright spot for Arizona's offense, reeling in nearly half of the team's 95 total passing yards in the game. The tight end was able to find the end zone for a second straight contest to open the regular season, snagging a two-yard score from Jacoby Brissett on the opening play of the second quarter. McBride is coming off of one of the most dominant seasons for a tight end in NFL history, and he's now off to a hot start in 2026, catching 17 of 22 targets for 136 yards and two scores over the Cardinals' first two games.

feed.headline: McBride brought in nine of 12 targets for 95 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals' 26-14 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
feed.description: McBride brought in nine of 12 targets for 95 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals' 26-14 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
feed.story: McBride was in the familiar position of leading the Cardinals across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, while also being on the receiving end of Jacoby Brissett's one touchdown pass. McBride recorded his three-yard scoring grab early in the fourth quarter, a critical touchdown considering it extended what had been a narrow 16-14 lead for Arizona. The talented tight end's performance was all the more impressive considering the presence of All-Pro safety Derwin James on the other side, and McBride will look to carry over his significant season-opening momentum into a Week 2 divisional home clash with the defending champion Seahawks next Sunday.

feed.headline: Fantasy football sleepers, busts and breakouts for 2026
feed.description: Which players will surprise, disappoint or make a big jump this fantasy season? Our analysts give their picks.
feed.story:
As fantasy football draft season inches closer and closer, it's time for our annual predictions of sleepers, busts and breakout players. Interpretations of the terms can vary for each, but here are the definitions for our purposes:

• Sleeper: A player who is being overlooked and will outperform his average draft position (ADP) in 2026.
• Bust: A highly regarded player who will underperform in 2026, relative to his ADP/ranking.
• Breakout: A player who will put up career-best numbers in 2026 and make a huge impact.

feed.headline: Fantasy football fast facts: Quick-hit notes to get you ready for your draft
feed.description: Forgot to do your fantasy football homework and need some facts on big names at the most important positions?
feed.story:
Welcome to Labor Day weekend, the busiest time on the fantasy football draft calendar. Don't challenge me, as I have the power of ESPN Research to back that up! Some of you might not have put in your homework because it seemed so far away (kind of like your humanities course in college). But now it's final exam time, and you didn't study. And yes, I still have that same recurring dream.

I know, there is so much more we could talk about, but I wanted to give you the CliffsNotes to get you started for a great draft weekend. And one last thing, if you play in a fantasy league with somebody who provides fantasy analysis for a living -- maybe ask him or her if there was any breaking news before the draft. I know that seems hyper specific, and it's meant to be because my friend didn't do that last weekend. But still, just do a quick news search while you're hitting the charcuterie board before the draft. (Also not to brag, but I spelled charcuterie correctly on the first try. My first win of the season.)

Here are some fast facts (and a little opinion) to help you get through your draft prep.
